map.慢性阻塞性肺疾病评估测试(CAT)，8项0–5分，总分0–40，评估COPD对患: COPD Assessment Test (CAT): 8 items scored 0-5, total 0-40, assessing the impact of COPD on health status
map.📖 查看「COPD CAT 评估问卷器 使用指南」: 📖 View the COPD CAT Assessment Questionnaire user guide
map.COPD 评估测试 CAT 总分 = 8 个问题（每项 0 至 5）之和，满分: CAT total = sum of 8 questions (0 to 5 each), max 40; <=10 mild impact, <=20 moderate, <=30 severe, >30 very severe.
map.📋 CAT 评分临床意义: 📋 Clinical meaning of the CAT score
map.影响轻微，维持治疗，关注急性加重: Minimal impact; maintain treatment, watch for exacerbations
map.影响中等，优化治疗，加强肺康复: Moderate impact; optimize treatment, strengthen pulmonary rehab
map.影响严重，强化药物与支持治疗: Severe impact; intensify medication and supportive care
map.影响极重，全面评估，多学科管理: Very severe impact; comprehensive assessment, multidisciplinary management
map.提示：CAT 是评估COPD健康状态的简明工具，建议每次随访复测。CAT变化≥2: Note: CAT is a brief tool for COPD health status; repeat at each visit. A CAT change >=2 points is clinically meaningful. GOLD recommends combining CAT, mMRC and exacerbation history for ABE grouping to guide treatment. Clinical reference only.
map.总分=8×2=16 分：10–20 为中度影响，建议含长效支扩剂治疗。: Total = 8 x 2 = 16: 10-20 is moderate impact; long-acting bronchodilator therapy advised.
map.总分≥20：症状重度，考虑 LAMA+LABA 或联合 ICS。: Total >=20: severe symptoms; consider LAMA+LABA or adding ICS.
map.CAT 全面评估症状/活动/心理，mMRC 仅呼吸困难；二者互补。: CAT covers symptoms/activity/psychology broadly, mMRC only breathlessness; the two complement each other.
map.每 3 月复评，变化≥2 分有临床意义。: Reassess every 3 months; a change >=2 points is clinically meaningful.
map.COPD(CAT评分)问卷器，慢性阻塞性肺疾病评估测试8题量表，评估COPD对患: COPD (CAT Score) Questionnaire: the 8-item COPD Assessment Test evaluating COPD impact on health status and guiding treatment adjustment. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
